description: An immutable object named after something that happened, published by the module that owns the fact.
The Spring component used to publish an event object to interested listeners.
An annotation that combines @Async, @Transactional with REQUIRES_NEW and @TransactionalEventListener.
A persistent record of publications that is marked completed only when a listener succeeds, so incomplete ones can be resubmitted.
Re-running incomplete publications after a failure or restart, which requires idempotent listeners.
A marker that forwards an event to a broker such as Kafka with the registry's reliability.
